scope: Independent primary-source check of V7's fixed eight-CREATE query/cursor projection; not a complete code approval or actual runtime result.

sources.fact: The stdin parser submits at a statement-ending semicolon, resets the query buffer, and resets statement scanning after submission.

The scanner excludes initial whitespace while its output buffer is empty. Together with query-buffer reset, this supports the fixed standalone CREATE statement even when the prepared input contains earlier BEGIN and SET statements on the same input line.
Creation-namespace validation uses an error-position callback bound to the relation token's parser location. V7's fixed ASCII query places that token immediately after its CREATE TABLE prefix.

The frontend converts the cursor offset to zero-based indexing, applies the60-column display limit with10-column right-cut margin, and builds the line/caret projection. V7 restricts the new special case to its fixed ASCII query/cursor and same hash-bound case/schema/run template.

source_reviewed_so_far.eight_CREATE_only: Fixed template hash/schema/role/case/run UUID/rendered SQL/query hash required; no arbitrary SQL splitting/search or generic42501 verdict.
